title: GPT-4o (May 2024)
reading: A slide headed "GPT-4o (May 2024)" whose body is a single screenshot, apparently a still frame from OpenAI's live GPT-4o demo video. There is no body text; the lecturer presumably plays or narrates the demo to illustrate the model's real-time multimodal (voice/vision) interaction capabilities.

visuals.description: Video still of two men seated at a small round table in a studio-like room with plants and wooden panelling; one laughs while the other looks down at a smartphone held in both hands, with papers on the table.
visuals.assertion: Illustrates the GPT-4o launch demo in which presenters interact conversationally with the model in real time via a phone.

concepts.name: GPT-4o
concepts.why_it_matters: OpenAI's May 2024 natively multimodal model, a milestone in real-time speech/vision interaction.
